findings.summary: Field validation errors do not trigger the form-level error alert or move focus, so users may not know why submission failed.
findings.fix: When profile field errors exist, render a focused error summary with links to affected controls and retain inline error associations.
findings.evidence: The alert was conditional on $profileError while field errors were rendered separately.

passed: Editable controls have associated labels and appropriate autocomplete values.
Inline field errors are associated with their controls and set aria-invalid.
Save confirmation is rendered with role=status; successful saves use a POST/redirect/GET flow.
notes: Assistive-technology announcement of the status message after the full-page redirect was not runtime-tested.
